info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Drivers-v2-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Drivers Listing API enables users to retrieve a comprehensive list of delivery drivers associated with food deliveries. This endpoint allows businesses to view driver profiles, monitor their availability, and manage deliveries effectively. Typical consumers of this API include delivery service providers, logistics coordinators, and application developers looking to integrate driver information into their platforms. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their operational efficiency and improve customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the deliveries associated with a specific driver. It provides a detailed overview of each delivery, including its status and relevant information.

requestBody.description: Contains the parameters necessary for retrieving driver delivery information. The request body must adhere to the defined schema and should include all required fields to ensure a successful response.
